messages.subject: compound plots with plotRefToTarget and 3D coords
parts:
Hi all,
I am trying to make a compound plot of TPS deformation grids generated from 3D coordinates. I figured out how to do this with grids from 2D coordinates from a post by Dr. Sherratt in r-bloggers from a while ago. But since the function generates X,Y and X,Z grids for 3D coordinates, these grids don't seem to fit into the layout together and instead just render in the plot window one at a time. I also tried the grid.arrange function in the gridExtra package, but the grids also don't seem to convert to grobs properly.

Is there a work-around for arranging multiple deformation grids like this?

Would also appreciate if anyone could let me know how to remove the "X, Y tps grid" titles or rename them.

thanks in advance,
Grant Haines
